title: Parasite
paragraphs: This is a sample review. Bong Joon-ho splits the house in two: the wider the upstairs glass, the narrower the downstairs window. Class is built like a staircase.
The smell scene turns the film over in a second. The plan that has been funny until then does not hide the shame.

title: In the Mood for Love
paragraphs: This is a sample review. Wong Kar-wai walks two neighbors down a narrow corridor. Everything left unsaid gathers inside a frame that keeps repeating.
Rain and the red wall are the film's real sentence. The parting has already started before the door closes.

title: The Worst Person in the World
paragraphs: This is a sample review. Joachim Trier sends Julie from one decision to the next. The film treats one's thirties as stacked attempts, not a waiting room.
The party where time stops is the film's plainest sentence: everyone stays put while she keeps walking.
